name: Jindal Stainless Ltd
title: Jindal Stainless Ltd - 532508 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Jindal Stainless guides FY27 volume +7-9% and H1 EBITDA/ton of INR18,000-20,000 despite gas cost spiking 2.5-3x; Indonesia melt shop (1.2 Mt) adds capacity while Maharashtra capex is still in land acquisition.

capex.peers_comment: Management said MSME and small producers with spare capacity were planning to expand, which the QCO suspension has disrupted.
capex.quote: the company announced an additional INR900 crores commitment towards augmenting cold rolling capacities at Hisar and Kharagpur

triggers.label: QCO suspended; imports of substandard product
triggers.quote: suspension of that opens the gate for the import of substandard products as well

triggers.label: Gas cost up 2.5x-3x; partial pass-through
triggers.quote: it has gone up close to 2.5x to 3x of what we were paying

triggers.label: Indonesia melt shop 1.2 Mt commissioned
triggers.quote: The 1.2 million tons per annum at the stainless steel melt shop in Indonesia is successfully commissioned ahead of schedule

triggers.label: FY27 volume +7-9%; EBITDA/t 18-20k H1
triggers.quote: we are expecting at least 8% to 10% growth -- 7% to 9% growth in volume this year

triggers.label: Export share fell to 8% from 9%
triggers.quote: export market has a different time with different challenges, we can say uncertainty

guidance.quote: we are expecting at least 8% to 10% growth -- 7% to 9% growth in volume this year
till H1 of this year, we are giving a guidance of INR18,000 to INR20,000 EBITDA per ton
For FY27, our capex guidance is around INR2,600 crores for FY27
This integrated expansion will support our sales volume target of 3.5 million tons per annum by FY29
up to 70%, 80% of the capacity should ramp up in this financial year

red_flags.label: Gas cost spike; price pass-through partial
red_flags.quote: Some cases we are, some cases we are not.

red_flags.label: Dependence on QCO; policy support uncertain
red_flags.quote: The temporary suspension of QCO is a matter of concern and poses a discouraging setback

evasions.topic: Gas cost quantum and EBITDA impact
evasions.quote: No, honestly, I don't have those figures with me right now. And that is something that we possibly would not like to share.
We will come back to you with that one.
Angad Khurana will get back to you with this calculation.
So that is not part of JSL so we don't really discuss that on this call.
